scope: Prospective source-disjoint Aya E5 fixed-site replication, separate by Arabic and Hebrew cohort
primary_per_cohort: Answer-stratum macro mean of subject-level (same-entity U-to-D patch margin minus unpatched D margin), where margin is gold-answer total log likelihood minus the frozen distractor total log likelihood.

inference.unit: subject QID, clustered by answer stratum
inference.two_sided_sign_flip: Flip the signs of answer-stratum mean paired effects; enumerate all assignments for at most 18 strata, otherwise 200000 Monte Carlo assignments with plus-one correction.
inference.hierarchical_bootstrap: Resample answer strata with replacement and then subjects within each sampled stratum; 10000 replicates and percentile 95% interval.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the two cohort primary p-values

fixed_controls: Unrelated different-answer donor U-to-D patch minus unpatched D margin
Identity D-to-D patch minus unpatched D margin, checked for near-zero numerical difference
First-subject U-to-D patch minus unpatched D margin
Gold-only likelihood gain for comparability with earlier E5
integrity: Check all 192 E5 records, donors, hashes, and response-score arithmetic; reproduce the new source-cohort E2 t1 unpatched U/D scores to within 0.1 nat for every gold and distractor score.
limits: No generated-answer claim from this likelihood-only replication.
The fixed site was selected in previous Aya experiments, so this is a transfer test, not independent localization.
Whole-residual patching is not a pure token-count intervention.
The Arabic country and Hebrew subdistrict relations are not matched and absolute outcomes are not directly comparable.
